intro: I want to express my interest in the ESG Manager position at Acme. As someone who has taken CSRD reporting from a blank page to an audited submission, I know my mix of regulatory rigour and hands-on platform work would help your team move faster.
experiences: My experience spans corporate ESG and applied carbon work, from standing up ESRS reporting at TUI AG to running product-level LCA studies at KarbonWise. I am looking to take the next step by leading sustainability reporting end to end for a company that treats it as core, not compliance theatre.

skills.name: CSRD and ESRS reporting
skills.body: I learned reporting by doing it under deadline. At TUI AG I owned the move onto the osapiens platform during our first full CSRD cycle. The data was scattered across business units and nobody agreed on definitions. I mapped our double-materiality results to the right ESRS datapoints and got sign-off from each owner. The result was a submission that held up in assurance review without major rework.

skills.name: Carbon accounting and LCA
skills.body: Numbers only matter if someone can defend them. At KarbonWise I run product-level LCA and PCF studies in OneClick LCA. Suppliers send messy spreadsheets and partial factors. I clean the inputs, pick defensible boundaries, and document every assumption. Clients now walk into customer audits with footprints they can explain line by line.
